## What this changes

A short description of the change and why.

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix (patch)
- [ ] New, backward-compatible capability (minor)
- [ ] Breaking config/behavior change (major)
- [ ] Docs / chore (no release)

## Checklist

- [ ] One concern per PR
- [ ] `composer test` passes (pure Core suite)
- [ ] `shopware-cli extension validate .` passes
- [ ] Added a `CHANGELOG.md` entry (unless docs/chore) — see [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md)
- [ ] Did **not** change any externally-stable id (`xyz.fd.prism_payment`, fixed UUIDs)
- [ ] Added/updated tests for changed `Core/` behavior

## Notes for reviewers

Anything reviewers should focus on, or context that isn't obvious from the diff.
